Cookie & storage controls

Updated October 11, 2026.

Necessary storage

Office and Crew use browser storage for signed-in sessions and offline job work. The website may remember a dismissed audience banner and your privacy preference. These functions support the experience you requested. Signing out and clearing browser data affect stored sessions and unsynced work.

Optional measurement

Choose whether this browser may send basic website funnel events. These events should not include contact details or calculator amounts. Optional measurement starts off until you select it. Your choice does not stop necessary security logs or erase already-collected records.

Marketing preferences

Measurement and marketing email are different choices. Use the contact form to opt out of marketing. Account and service notices may continue where permitted.

Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share

We do not currently sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising, use targeted advertising, or load Google Analytics, Meta pixels, advertising cookies or session replay. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track turn off optional first-party analytics even if it was previously allowed. You do not need an account to use these browser controls. Rejecting analytics also removes campaign/referrer attribution from new form submissions. Necessary account and security functions continue.

Homeowner referrals are a separate choice: if you explicitly agree to share your request when no provider is available, eligible lawn-care businesses may pay to access that referral. This exchange may qualify as a sale under applicable state law; it is not an advertising cookie. To withdraw optional referral sharing or request a sale/sharing opt-out, submit a privacy correction request and state “Stop sharing my homeowner referral.” We review and apply the request to future disclosures; prior disclosures cannot be recalled. Browser analytics controls do not withdraw previously submitted referral permission.

Storage and duration

Your privacy preference uses local storage, lasts 180 days, and is limited to this browser and website origin. Optional analytics uses a random identifier for the current page session. We do not set analytics or advertising cookies. Authentication and offline work use separate necessary storage. Clearing browser storage resets your choice to analytics off. Changing your choice does not retroactively delete records; use the contact form to request deletion.

Future tracking tools

New analytics or advertising integrations require a reviewed notice, a tested consent gate and opt-out handling before activation.
